program:
domain(person,[raelynn,major]).
% Raelynn prioritizes stability.
axiom(s1, prioritizes(raelynn,stability)).
% Raelynn does not take risks.
axiom(s2, not(takes_risks(raelynn))).
% Raelynn is curious.
axiom(s3, curious(raelynn)).
% If someone either pushes boundaries or works with traditional techniques (but not both), then they are innovative.
axiom(s4, rule([xor(pushes_boundaries(X),works_with_traditional_techniques(X))],innovative(X))).
% If Raelynn is innovative or takes risks, then she will achieve success.
axiom(s5, rule([or(innovative(raelynn),takes_risks(raelynn))],achieve_success(raelynn))).
% If Raelynn has a creative vision, then she will either achieve success or build a strong network, but not both.
axiom(s6, rule([creative_vision(raelynn)],xor(achieve_success(raelynn),builds_strong_network(raelynn)))).
% If Raelynn is curious, then she either thinks outside the box or pushes boundaries, but not both.
axiom(s7, rule([curious(raelynn)],xor(thinks_outside_the_box(raelynn),pushes_boundaries(raelynn)))).
% If Major experiments with materials, then she creates innovative products.
axiom(s8, rule([experiments_with_materials(major)],creates_innovative_products(major))).
% Raelynn does not think outside the box.
axiom(s9, not(thinks_outside_the_box(raelynn))).
% Raelynn either experiments with materials or works with traditional techniques, but not both.
axiom(s10, xor(experiments_with_materials(raelynn),works_with_traditional_techniques(raelynn))).
% Major does not take risks.
axiom(s11, not(takes_risks(major))).
% Raelynn either prioritizes stability or can achieve success, but not both.
axiom(s12, xor(prioritizes(raelynn,stability),can_achieve_success(raelynn))).
